actor: CrownThrive Founding Member directive via governed GitHub connector
reason: Remove workflow-wide GitHub OIDC issuance, move pull-request validation onto a credential-free read-only job, and prevent provider credential binding or live-readback jobs from executing on pull_request events while preserving trusted push, schedule, and manual execution.

changes.reason: Enforce least privilege across both OIDC issuance and provider-secret execution on pull requests.

exclusions: No provider credential, private key, raw secret, or Vault value was read or changed.
No production deployment, provider write, money movement, entitlement, rights grant, or authority expansion was performed.
No trusted push, schedule, manual provider execution, certification, or evidence path was removed.
